# Jira Cloud API coverage

Every operation in Atlassian's published OpenAPI specs for Jira Cloud, and what `jira` does with it. Generated: edit `coverage/mapping.json`, then run `npm run coverage` (add `-- --fetch` to pull the latest specs first). A test fails when the specs and the mapping disagree.

- **Wrapped**: a command calls this operation.
- **Not wrapped**: allowed with an ordinary API token, no command yet. `jira api <path> -X <method>` still reaches it.
- **Won't do**: closed to an ordinary user token, or not worth a command, for the reason given.

## Headline

| **Spec** | **Operations** | **Wrapped** | **Not wrapped** | **Admin only** | **App only** | **Deprecated** | **Premium only** | **Other** | **Wrapped of reachable** |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Jira Cloud platform REST API (v3) | 630 | 49 | 275 | 216 | 51 | 22 | 16 | 1 | 15% |
| Jira Software Cloud REST API (Agile 1.0) | 105 | 15 | 42 | 0 | 44 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 26% |

"Reachable" is wrapped plus not wrapped: what an ordinary API token can call at all.

## Won't-do reasons

| **Reason** | **Why** | **Fallback** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin only | needs the Administer Jira global permission | ask a Jira admin (the refusal message drafts the request) |
| App only | callable by Connect or Forge apps, or OAuth integrations | not reachable with an API token |
| Deprecated | marked deprecated in the spec | use the replacement Atlassian names in the reference |
| Premium only | Jira Premium (Plans) features | open the plan in the web UI |
| Other | see the note on the row | see the note on the row |

## Private board API (not counted)

Most board configuration has no public write. Jira's web UI uses a private API, `/rest/greenhopper/1.0`, that Atlassian does not document or support. The CLI reaches it only behind `--private-api`, from `src/commands/greenhopper.ts`, and none of it counts as coverage above.

| **Method** | **Path** | **Function** | **Commands** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/rest/greenhopper/1.0/rapidviewconfig/editmodel.json` | `getEditModel` | `jira board settings`, `jira board swimlanes`, `jira board colours` |
| PUT | `/rest/greenhopper/1.0/cardcolors/{boardId}/strategy` | `setCardColorStrategy` | `jira board colours strategy` |
| POST | `/rest/greenhopper/1.0/cardcolors/{boardId}/color` | `addCardColor` | `jira board colours set` |
| PUT | `/rest/greenhopper/1.0/cardcolors/{boardId}/color/{colorId}` | `updateCardColor` | `jira board colours set` |
| DELETE | `/rest/greenhopper/1.0/cardcolors/{boardId}/color/{colorId}` | `removeCardColor` | `jira board colours remove` |

The edit model read carries card colours, swimlanes, card layout, working days and board admins.

Board settings only the private API can change, and nothing wraps yet:

| **Setting** | **Note** |
| --- | --- |
| Quick filters: create, edit, delete, reorder | public API reads them; writes exist only in the private API |
| Swimlanes: strategy, create, edit, delete | read through the edit model |
| Columns: add, rename, move, status mapping, WIP limits | public API reads them |
| Card layout fields | read through the edit model |
| Working days and non-working dates | read through the edit model |
| Estimation statistic and time tracking | public API reads them |
| Board administrators | read through the edit model and board?expand=admins |

## Outside these specs

- **Automation** has its own API (`/gateway/api/automation/public/jira/{cloudId}/rest/v1`), outside both specs: `jira automation list/get/create/update/enable/disable` wrap it. Managing rules needs Administer Jira.
- **Reports** (sprint report, velocity, burndown) are in no public API.

What other Jira tools wrap, for comparison: [coverage-peers.md](./coverage-peers.md).
